$comment: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. SHA-256 of every file scripts/build-tokens.cjs emits. The generated partials are not committed, so this is the only committed record of what the generator produces. Regenerate with `node scripts/build-tokens.cjs --baseline` in the same commit as the tokens/*.yaml change that moved it. MERGE CONFLICTS: never resolve one by hand or by picking a side on merit - these values are a function of the generator and the token sources, not of either branch's intent, so a hand-merged digest is simply wrong. Take either side to clear the conflict, then re-run --baseline and commit what it writes. A branch that changes what the generator emits (for example by adding a mixin) will legitimately have its own baseline, and taking the other side without re-running leaves a digest that no longer describes anything.
